results.question: How many customers do we have?

detail.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers

results.question: Show me the top 5 customers by total spend.

detail.sql: SELECT cu.full_name, ROUND(SUM(o.amount), 2) AS total_spend FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id GROUP BY cu.full_name ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: What is the revenue per campaign?

detail.sql: SELECT c.campaign_name, ROUND(SUM(o.amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN campaigns c ON o.campaign_id = c.campaign_id GROUP BY c.campaign_name ORDER BY revenue DESC

results.question: What are the top 3 campaigns by revenue?

detail.sql: SELECT c.campaign_name, ROUND(SUM(o.amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN campaigns c ON o.campaign_id = c.campaign_id GROUP BY c.campaign_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: Which marketing channel has the best ROI?

detail.sql: WITH rev AS (SELECT campaign_id, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY campaign_id) SELECT c.channel, ROUND((SUM(COALESCE(rev.revenue, 0)) - SUM(c.spend)) / NULLIF(SUM(c.spend), 0), 3) AS roi FROM campaigns c LEFT JOIN rev ON rev.campaign_id = c.campaign_id GROUP BY c.channel ORDER BY roi DESC

results.question: What is the average order value by category?

detail.sql: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY category ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

results.question: Which categories have an average order value above 100?

detail.sql: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders GROUP BY category HAVING AVG(amount) > 100 ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

results.question: How many orders were placed in June 2026?

detail.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) = '2026-06'

results.question: How many orders did each channel drive?

detail.sql: SELECT c.channel, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN campaigns c ON o.campaign_id = c.campaign_id GROUP BY c.channel ORDER BY orders DESC

results.question: What is our total marketing spend?

detail.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(spend), 2) AS total_spend FROM campaigns
